itineraries.summary: Day-by-day 9-day Iceland road-trip itinerary posted by Christian LeBlanc (@lostleblanc) on his verified TikTok account: Reykjavik and lagoons on day 1, Silfra diving on day 2, the Golden Circle on day 3, horse riding, snowmobiling, glacier caves, canyons and a glacier lagoon boat trip on days 4-8, and departure via Egilsstaðir Airport or ferry to the Faroe Islands on day 9.
itineraries.title: DO NOT GO TO ICELAND... without this itinerary! (9-Day Iceland)

itineraries.summary: 12-day Bali itinerary from his 2020 YouTube travel video (described by a third-party writeup): a couple of days to get over jet lag at the start, visiting Canggu, Berawa Beach, Uluwatu and Ubud, with highlights including waterfalls, cuisine and adults-only resorts. He also recommends Nusa Penida as a hidden gem off the mainland.
itineraries.title: How To Travel Bali – 14 Days in Paradise

notes: All content is from Christian LeBlanc (@lostleblanc) himself - verified TikTok account and his YouTube channel (one Bali summary via third-party writeup). The Iceland itinerary is the only full day-by-day plan in text form; everything else he publishes is video narration. His site lostleblanc.com is now purely a creator-academy funnel with no travel guides. The '3 Days in Bohol' YouTube video is billed as a 3-day guide but its description contains no day-level text, so it was excluded rather than inferred. No prices or booking links appear in any source.
